**Order filled: BUY 22 AAPL @ $223.00 limit — $4,906 total.**

**Summary of what I did and why:** I checked the live quote (AAPL $222.70, bid/ask $222.68/$222.72) and then attempted web research on Apple's latest results and news. I have to be candid about a limitation: the web_search tool returned only boilerplate aggregator pages ("Apple Inc. shares were little changed on Wednesday as analysts weighed demand and the outlook; roundup 1–6") plus stale FY2023 references, and the Apple Newsroom Q4 FY2024 page was unavailable. I fetched all six aggregator pages and they contained no substantive content — no segment detail, no guidance, no analyst commentary. So my decision rests on the trusted SEC-filed figures rather than on news flow, and I sized the position modestly in recognition of that thinner information base. The fundamentals I relied on: FY2024 (10-K filed 2024-11-01) revenue of $391,035M, up ~2.0% from FY2023's $383,285M; net income of $93,736M versus $96,995M prior year; diluted EPS of $6.08 versus $6.13; and operating cash flow of $118,254M — a business still generating enormous cash even with modestly lower earnings. I bought 22 shares at a $223.00 limit, roughly 0.13% above the last trade, which satisfies the "close to market" requirement, and the $4,906 notional sits under both the $5,000 per-order cap and the $10,000 daily cap. The order was funded entirely from existing cash ($50,000 available), so no money left the account, and the only pre-existing position (20 INTC shares) was untouched. One caveat worth flagging: because I could not verify current news or the Q4 FY2024 quarterly detail, this is a fundamentals-and-cash-flow-driven starter position rather than a news-confirmed entry — if you want, I can retry the research later or add on confirmation.
